3184.title: Browser-focused host shortcuts are filtered out
3184.rootCauseOneLine: The desktop browser resolver ignores every configured binding that does not explicitly require browserFocus, so numbered thread commands resolve to null.
3184.proposedFix: Synchronize an active host-owned shortcut registry from the renderer to Electron main, including opaque plugin registrations, and suppress browser defaults only for active matches.
3184.caveats: Embedded content was reproduced twice; the address-field and named third-party-plugin subclaims were not directly executed.
